newsitem.title: CHINA: China yuan interbank market trades 587.2 bln yuan.
newsitem.headline: China yuan interbank market trades 587.2 bln yuan.

text.p: China's national local currency interbank market based in Shanghai traded 587.2 billion yuan in 1996, the first of year of its operation, the Shanghai Securities News said on Saturday.
The market was launched in early 1996 to allow banks to borrow and lend surplus short-term funds among themselves.

Weighted average interest rates in 1996 for the seven contracts listed on the market was 11.352 percent for the one-day contract, 11.769 percent for the seven-day contract, 11.866 for 20 days, 12.039 for 30 days, 12.164 for 60 days, 12.328 for 90 days and 12.6 for 120 days, it said.

"The establishment of the Chinese yuan interbank market in 1996 has expanded liquidity of funds at the national level," the newspaper said. "It has also helped financial institutions to more effectively use and manage their funds." ($1 = 8.3 yuan)
